smtp.label: SMTP Settings
smtp.title: Platform SMTP Settings
smtp.description: Outbound SMTP server infrastructure for DoğruAdres email verification, user invitations, and transaction notifications.
smtp.authError: Additional authentication with an authorized platform account is required to manage SMTP settings.
smtp.authSubtext: Try again after completing strong authentication.
smtp.loadError: Failed to load SMTP settings. Please refresh the page and try again later.
smtp.serviceDesc: When disabled, outbound emails are queued in the Transactional Outbox.
smtp.securitySslDesc: Direct TLS socket connection; encryption is active before handshake.
smtp.securityTlsDesc: Plain-text initial TLS upgrade; credentials transmitted after TLS.
smtp.saveConflict: Concurrent modification conflict! Refresh the page and try again.
smtp.testDesc: Send a test email; verify acceptance by the server and inbox delivery separately.
smtp.testRecipientValidation: Enter a recipient address for the test email.
smtp.testSuccessMessage: Email accepted for delivery. Check inbox for delivery.
smtp.testSuccessToast: SMTP server accepted email for delivery.

mfa.label: Platform MFA
mfa.title: Platform Security — Multi-Factor Authentication
mfa.description: This operation is restricted to platform staff with specific MFA management permissions.
mfa.denied: Unauthorized access. Organization Owner or SMTP roles do not grant this permission.
mfa.notEnforced: MFA runtime is not yet enabled; product acceptance is pending.
mfa.note: This change does not delete existing native MFA factors. The disabled option is not a full shutdown until native factor reconciliation is complete.
mfa.requiredEffect: MFA is required even if user preference is off; factor setup may be required.
mfa.optionalEffect: Users can change their own MFA preference; active factors are not automatically removed.
mfa.disabledEffect: Aims to halt new MFA usage. Existing native factors may still require verification until secure reconciliation.
mfa.confirmPrompt: Do you want to change the platform MFA policy? {{name}}: {{effect}} Existing native factors cannot be bypassed without secure reconciliation.
mfa.errUnauthorized: Active MFA platform role and strong session are required for this action.
mfa.errConflict: Settings changed in another session. Reload to compare versions.
mfa.errUnverified: Save could not be verified. Do not resend; read current settings first.
mfa.errInconsistent: Server response is inconsistent. Read current settings before resending.
mfa.errNetwork: Network response uncertain. Read current settings before resending.
mfa.warnUnverifiedVersion: Save response received, but current policy version could not be verified. Check again.
mfa.successVersion: New version verified from server. Native factor reconciliation is separately required.
mfa.errVerifyFailed: MFA policy could not be safely verified. Re-authenticate with a strong session or refresh the page.
